highlights.title: Virat Kohli passes 15,000 ODI runs as India beat West Indies
highlights.summary: Kohli remained not out on 139 off 88 balls as the hosts romped to an eight-wicket win in their first ODI of the series.

highlights.title: ‘Still a lockdown’: Deadly floods hit Nepal tourism as peak season begins
highlights.summary: As Himalayan nation recovers from devastating floods, a million people dependent on tourism struggle to make ends meet.

highlights.title: Chanceler da Arábia Saudita chega a Washington para reunião com Rubio
highlights.summary: Encontro ocorre em meio à escalada de hostilidades entre Riad e houthis do Iêmen, apoiados pelo Irã

highlights.title: Russian strikes kill eight, injure dozens across Ukraine
highlights.summary: Ukrainian leader Zelenskyy says Moscow launched nearly 4,000 drones, aerial bombs and missiles on Ukraine in past week.

highlights.title: Sudanese army impounds dozens of motorcycles in Blue Nile curfew
highlights.summary: Dozens of motorcycles were impounded in Sudan’s Blue Nile State, after their riders were accused of flouting a curfew.

highlights.title: Serbia’s president resigns to run for prime minister
highlights.summary: Serbia’s Aleksandar Vucic has resigned as president and will lead his ruling party into a snap parliamentary election.
